systems.tiers: Two districts chosen with the ministry as learning sites, since 2024; a research project on sub-national data management and use

note: The page gives the DHIS2 product in use as Aggregate and describes district-level data management, with no per-learner record and no school entering data, so the system is not class emis and gives no fact. It does not say how often the aggregate data is collected; census is the nearest class and the parent may prefer it unclassified.
